description: Weatherbee’s Recipe Card Dividers keep recipe cards neat, organized and easier to find with preprinted tabs in 24 food popular categories. Find the desired recipe cards at the ready for food preparation. Great for keepsake recipes, family favorites and treasured holiday recipes. These simple recipe organizers are functional additions to cooking accessories, offering quick access to saved recipes with little fuss. Printed tabs include appetizer, barbecue, beef, beverage, bread, cake, candy, casserole, cheese, cookies, dessert, eggs, fish, frosting, lamb, pasta, pie, pork, poultry, salad, sauces, soup, veal, and vegetable. Proudly made in America from card stock. They’re compact for easy storage and organize the family recipe card holder and recipe box. Easy to use. Avoid contact with moisture. Set of 24 recipe card dividers.
